text: Hello, boys and girls.Welcome to Nina's class again.Today, we will go on reading the fairy tale, the happy farmer and his wife.We will learn how to use the adverbial clause of concession.And we will also talk about how to live a happy life.Are you ready?Here we go.First of all, open your student's book, please, and turn to page 33.You were told to finish this script as your homework last lesson.Let's check the homework now.I'm going to be the narrator.And three of my students will be the luck fairy, Fred and Doris.Let's go.Long ago, there was a poor farmer called Fred.He and his wife, Doris, lived in an old small hut.Fred, you are a good and hardworking farmer.I'm going to give you three wishes.Thank you very much.We don't need any wishes.Although we are old, we walk in the fields every day.You're poor.I can give you some gold coins.Although we are poor, we live happily.Your hut is old and small.I can give you a big new house.Although our hut is old and small, it's very comfortable.How about some beautiful clothes?Although our clothes are old, they are still comfortable.You're not greedy.I wish you happiness and health forever.Then the luck fairy disappeared.Please pay attention to the pronunciation of field.Read after me.Good job.Boys and girls, have you noticed that both Fred and Doris used the sentences with although to respond to the fairy.Please read the script on page 33 and underline the sentences with although.Okay, have you found them?What are they?Well, let's read together.Although we are old, we work in the fields every day.And Doris said, although we are poor, we live happily.Fred said, although our hut is old and small, it's very comfortable.And Doris said, although our clothes are old, they are still comfortable.Well, think it over.Can you express the same meanings in another way?Okay, let's have a try.We are old, but we work in the fields every day.We are poor, but we live happily.Our hut is old and small, but it's very comfortable.Our clothes are old, but they are still comfortable.By rewriting them, we can get the conclusion that although and but can be exchanged in the same sentence.To be specific, for example, although our clothes are old, they are still comfortable.Look, our clothes are old, but they are still comfortable.They have the same meaning.However, we cannot use although and but in one sentence.Then, boys and girls, can we work together with the luck fairy to roleplay the story with our books closed?Ready?How are you?I'm luck fairy.I'd like to give you three wishes.Do you need anything?Although we're old, we work in the fields every day.You are poor.Although we're poor, we live happily.Well, your hut is old and small.Look, your clothes are old.What about some beautiful clothes?Although our clothes are old, they're still comfortable.All right, you are not greedy.I like you very much.Fabulous!At the end of the story, the luck fairy disappeared.Where did she go?Can you guess?Haha, I can tell you, she returned to the kingdom of the fairies.And she needed to write a report to the king of the fairies.Can you help her?Thank you.It's very kind of you.Please take out your worksheets and finish task one.Hi, how is your report going?Who can have a try?Let's invite one of my students.Please pay attention to the pronunciation of hut.Hut, as we all know, Fred and his wife didn't need the three wishes.However, what would they say if the luck fairy gave them other wishes?Such as some delicious food, some new furniture, a few helpers, or a large farm.Suppose you are the luck fairy and Fred or Doris, please prepare the dialogue within one minute.Hut, as we all know, Fred and Doris, please prepare the dialogue within one minute.Suppose you are the luck fairy and Doris, please prepare the dialogue within one minute.I can give you some delicious food.Although we don't have much food, it's enough and healthy for us.What about some new furniture?Although our furniture is old, is very comfortable, we have used it for a long time.You are very old, I can give you a few helpers to work for you.Thank you, although we are old and not strong enough, we enjoy working in the fields every day, it's good for our health.How about a large farm?Although our farm is very small, it's very beautiful, we are very happy to live and work here.Oh, it seems that my students totally agree with Fred and Doris.They didn't need any material wealth, although they were really poor.Let's look at page 33 again.The beginning of the story is Long ago, there was a poor farmer called Fred.There are several sentences in the story, which describe how poor Fred and Doris were.Can you circle the words or sentences which show they were poor?Yes, you are right.We lived in an old small hut.They didn't earn much.Their clothes were old and not beautiful.Then, can we change the title into a poor farmer and his wife?Let's look at page 33 again and circle the words that show they were not poor.Are your answers the same as mine?Right, let's look.Happy, a happy farmer and his wife.Just like the title, live happily.A comfortable hut, comfortable clothes.By the way, don't forget the dialogue you've just made.Enough food, healthy food, enjoy walking, etc.Then, could you tell me whether they were poor farmers or happy farmers?Oh yes, of course, they were happy farmers.They lived a happy life.Then, boys and girls, are you living a happy life?Do you know how to live a happy life?As we all know, everyone may be poor in some ways.For example, some people are short, some people are shy or not brave enough.However, just like Fred and Doris, although they were poor, they lived a happy life because they always saw the bright side of life.Then, could you say something about yourself?What do you do to live a happy life?Think it over please.You can also write down some sentences on your worksheet.Thank you for watching.Hi, can you say something about your happy life?Let me share some ideas from my students.LookAlthough I'm shy, I have many true friends.Although I'm not brave enough, I'd like to challenge myself.Although I'm short, I enjoy playing basketball.Wow, I can't agree with them more.Sports, friends, and courage are the source of our happy life.I'm sure different people have different ideas.Then, what about you?Time is limited, and we cannot share all of your ideas here.You can share your ideas with your friends and your parents.Okay, it's time to say goodbye.Don't forget your homework.See you next time.Bye-bye.
